description.value: Roy's Towne Pub is a well-established neighbourhood pub sitting right on the South Island Highway in Royston, in the heart of the Comox Valley between Courtenay and Union Bay. Under current ownership since 2021, it serves classic pub meals, cold drinks, and hosts regular live music featuring local artists across rock, folk, Celtic, jazz, country, and blues. It's a genuine community hub with ample on-site parking and a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at theroypub.com was successfully fetched and is active, confirming Roy's Towne Pub is open daily with full food service and explicit takeout availability. OSM contact details (phone 250-898-8768, address 4000 South Island Highway/4000 Island Hwy S) are corroborated by the website. No bike-specific amenities, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill are mentioned anywhere on the website, so those fields are null per the absence-of-evidence rule.
concerns: Minor address formatting difference: OSM uses 'South Island Highway' while the website uses 'Island Hwy S' — both refer to the same location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open, publicly accessible pub on the South Island Highway cycling corridor, confirmed active with current operating hours and a June 2026 music calendar on the website.
